basic_profile.headline: Sales Development & GTM Leader | Building, Scaling & Turning Around Pipeline Generation Teams | GTM Engineering & AI | Exit Experienced

current.name: Aligned
current.title: Director of Business Development
current.description:
A few milestones I'm proud of so far:
- Transformed GTM strategy: Shifted prospecting from primarily PLG-driven to a scalable MM & Enterprise outbound motion, creating a new pipeline engine for the business.
- +44% average deal size: Increased the average deal size entering pipeline as the organization moved upmarket.
- Record pipeline generation: Delivered the two largest outbound pipeline-generation quarters in company history.
- 6x BDR organization: Scaled the team from 2 → 12 BDRs and built out the company's first BDR management layer.
- 30% lower GTM spend: Rebuilt GTM systems, processes, and technology to reduce spend by 30% while increasing pipeline generation and efficiency.
- Built a PLG scoring system using Claude, Tableau, and HubSpot to analyze free-user behavior, identify high-intent accounts and users, and translate product engagement signals into actionable Business Development outreach.
- AI-native GTM: Established AI fluency across the revenue organization, embedding AI into prospecting, research, enablement, operations, and day-to-day GTM workflows.
- Built the operating infrastructure across people, process, data, technology, and AI required to scale the new outbound motion.

current.name: Silvry
current.title: Founder
current.description:
I founded Silvry as a part-time educational venture to help experienced professionals—especially those in sales and education—learn how to adopt and apply AI responsibly. Many mid- to late-career professionals feel left behind by rapid technological change; Silvry exists to bridge that gap through clear, hands-on instruction that builds confidence, not dependence.

What I Do at Silvry:
Deliver 1:1 and group AI education sessions focused on safe, ethical use
Create custom AI adoption playbooks for sales teams and educators
Offer ongoing support and guidance to ensure confident, independent use
Advocate for accessible AI education that empowers professionals, not replaces them
